query: SELECT e.lifecycle_status,i.status AS incident_status,i.resolved_at,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.event_status_history h JOIN public.cleanup_workflow_statuses s ON s.id=h.to_workflow_status_id WHERE h.cleanup_event_id=e.id AND s.code=$2) AS history_count FROM public.cleanup_events e JOIN public.incidents i ON i.id=e.incident_id WHERE e.id=$1
